svg.text: claudia composes — references in the text (cross-references)
Proposal for review — nothing is built (E9.30). A reference stores the id of what it points at and what to show; the number, text or page is derived, so it never goes stale.
Two entries join the Insert menu (D560); in creates and computes the first is off.
References go into texts; text boxes get them later
Cross-Reference… puts a reference at the caret and opens the picker (B).
Table of Contents: see the sheet composes-table-of-contents.svg.
Viewers: both off. A locked zone (± n words of a colleague) refuses as typing does.
B · The picker: what to point at, and what to show
It opens at the caret. It lists the whole document, not only what is in view (the chat’s # list does that).
… the numbers depend on how we measured, see section

C · On a reference: its menu
Right-click, the context-menu key or Shift+F10.
Name is off: the heading has none.
D · A reference in the text, and its states
It is one character to the caret, cursors, locks and authorship (a U+FFFC with its field). It is drawn as an atom that cannot be typed into.
A quiet iris underline; the colour
of the text otherwise. The caret
steps over it in one move.
the second deletes it, so it is
not lost by a slip of the finger.
The heading was deleted by ann at 14:02
mends it; going there replays the
history to the heading’s last moment.
The page is known on the page
Flow view has no pages: a muted #.
Page view and print show the
Nothing is refreshed by hand. Every change below is somebody else’s ordinary step; the reference is worked out again in the kernel and every reader sees the new text at once.
A chapter is put in before 2
Its heading is retyped (Show as: Text)
Its heading is deleted, then undone
Collaboration: putting in, changing and removing a reference are steps in the history, undoable, refused in a
colleague’s zone like typing. A reference to a paragraph in somebody’s zone is fine: it only reads it.
Keys: Ctrl+F2 puts one in; Ctrl+Alt+Enter goes to the target; Shift+F10 opens its menu (C).
Screen readers: “Reference to heading 2.1, Two sites, twelve weeks”; a broken one says “missing reference”.
Files: ODT bookmark-ref, docx REF/PAGEREF fields, \ref in LaTeX, a link in Markdown; the shown text is the
cached result, so other programs show it before they update.
· a bookmark inside a paragraph (a word as target)
· “above / below” as a way to show
· the AI putting references in (as with lists)
The field keeps a thing id, so these slot in later.
